terms.accept: I accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in with your email address, or with the username your teacher gave you.
login.identifierHint: Pupils type the username their teacher gave them, without an email address.
login.invalidCredentials: We could not log you in with that email or username and password. Check them and try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: Students aged 13 and over and teachers sign up with an email address. Younger students join with a class code from their teacher.

role.studentDescription: I want to learn AI through real projects.
role.teacherDescription: I want to teach and create with AI.

signup.displayNameHint: The name your teacher and classmates will see.
signup.emailHint: We will send a confirmation link to this address.

ageBand.hint: Under 13? Ask your teacher for a class code and join your class instead.

signup.emailTaken: An account already exists for this email address. Log in, or reset your password if you forgot it.

verifyEmail.title: Check your inbox
verifyEmail.description: We sent a confirmation link to your email address. Open it, then come back here and log in.
verifyEmail.spam: Nothing there? Look in your spam folder, or send the link again.
verifyEmail.resent: A new link is on its way.
verifyEmail.resendWait: You can send another link in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
verifyEmail.needLogin: To get a new link, log in with your email address and password: the link is sent again automatically.

join.title: Join your class
join.description: Type the 8-character code your teacher gave you.
join.codeHint: Letters and numbers; spaces and dashes are ignored.
join.codeNotFound: This code is not recognised. Check it with your teacher: a code stops working 24 hours after it is shared.

noAccountCreation.title: This class cannot create new accounts
noAccountCreation.description: If you already have an account, log in and open this page again to join {className}. If you have no account yet, ask your teacher.

account.title: Create your account
account.description: Choose a username and a password, and write them down: you will need both every time you log in.

join.displayNameHint: First name and last name, as your teacher knows you.
join.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. You log in with it instead of an email address.
join.usernameTaken: This username is already taken. Try another one.
join.classFull: This class is full. Ask your teacher.
join.notAllowed: This class cannot create an account for your age group. Ask your teacher.

done.title: Welcome to {className}!
done.description: Your account is ready. Remember your username: you will need it every time you log in.

signedIn.title: Join a class
signedIn.description: Enter the code your teacher gave you to join their class.

wrongRole.title: Only students join classes
wrongRole.description: You are signed in as {role}. Classes are managed from your own space.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.usernameNotice: A username has no mailbox. If you log in with a username, ask your teacher to reset your password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.description: If an account exists for {email}, a link to reset the password is on its way. It can take a minute to arrive.
